name: engnova
description: Engnova — one Android app hosting CEFR Academy and IELTS Level as two independent products behind a chooser.

scripts.cap:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npm run sync:android
scripts.build:apk:debug: npm run cap:android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.build:apk:release: npm run cap:android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.build:aab: npm run cap:android && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
